Headphones on. Let it warm you up.

The Sweet Heat cover is all glow: a pair of headphones resting in a stream of pink and violet light. It's uplifting R&B from Slamdino Entertainment ft. DJ Bombchelle, new this year.

Put it on for a cold walk home, a slow Sunday, or the drive when you need a lift.

posts.title: Scars & Silence
posts.instagram:
Some silences say everything.

On the cover of Scars & Silence, two people stand in a field of wildflowers at dusk, turned away from each other, with misty hills behind them. Calyx is the name on the cover, and it comes to you from Slamdino Entertainment, released this year.

Save it for a quiet night when you have a lot on your mind.

🌾 Scars & Silence · Calyx
